transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, I've been having some trouble with eating lately. Um, especially when I'm working late. I'll order dinner, but... it just ends up being a lot. Like, an entrée, sides, dessert... and then I'll keep eating snacks from the kitchen. It's... it's a lot more than I would ever eat if, you know, someone else was there with me.
After these episodes of eating a lot, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or do anything else to try to 'undo' the food you ate?
No. Um... I don't do anything like that. Just... no.
Do you ever feel like you can't control how much you're eating during these episodes?

Yeah... um. I guess so. It's just... once I start, there's this point where I'm kind of just watching myself do it. Like opening another package, and I'm thinking I really should stop, but... it just feels like the decision has already slipped out of my hands. So... yeah.
Do these episodes of eating a lot bother you, or have they caused any problems in your life, like with work, relationships, or how you feel about yourself?

Um... I don't really know. I guess it bothers me a little, sure. But... I still get my work done. I haven't really noticed it causing any big problems or anything like that. It's just... yeah, I don't know.
Do you feel distressed or upset about these episodes of eating more than you had planned?

Um... I mean, I guess I already said it bothers me a little. But... distressed? I don't know if I'd use that word. It's just... something that happens. I try not to think about it too much afterwards.
Do you usually end up eating this way when you're feeling stressed, anxious, or upset about something?
Um... maybe sometimes. I don't really keep track of... how I'm feeling when it happens. It just kind of happens. I haven't really noticed a specific pattern with stress or anything.
How often would you say these episodes of eating a lot happen? Like, how many times a week or month?

Um... I guess if I really think about it... or look at my delivery receipts... it's probably at least once a week. Sometimes maybe twice. It's... it's been going on like that for a few months now, I suppose.
After these episodes where you feel like you've eaten a lot, do you feel guilty, ashamed, or worried about what you've eaten?

Um... I don't really think so. I mean... I don't sit around feeling guilty or anything. Like I said before, I just try not to think about it once it's over. I just kind of... move on to the next thing.
Do you ever feel really upset, bothered, or distressed while these eating episodes are happening or after they happen?
Um... no, not really. I wouldn't say I get... distressed. Like I was saying before, I just kind of try not to dwell on it. It's just eating, so... I don't really let it bother me.
Do you feel unhappy with your body shape or weight, or worry a lot about gaining weight?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I don't really focus on that kind of thing. My weight is just... whatever it is. I don't really spend time worrying about it.
During these eating episodes, do you feel like you're not in control of what or how much you're eating, as if you're just going through the motions and can't stop yourself?

I guess... maybe a little. Once I start eating, sometimes I get to a point where I'm just... watching myself. Like, I'll keep opening another package, and in my head, I'm thinking I should probably stop, but... it just feels like the decision isn't really mine anymore. It just kind of slips out of my hands.
